title: Operations Executive
description:
We at Eon Infotech Ltd. are looking for Operations Executive. To succeed in this role, you must have exceptional operational competency and managerial skills. 
 Key Responsibilities: Manage the Customer Service Field Team and Support Technicians Professionally handle customer calls and resolve complaints Coordinate with clients, the production team, and management Monitor Vehicle Tracking System (VTS) devices through dashboards, MIS, and web apps Plan replacements and maintenance for faulty devices Conduct customer training sessions on VTS operations and report generation Perform GPS data analysis Update information systems and maintain accurate records Report progress and status updates to both customers and internal teams Assist with other VTS-related activities as required by the client 
 Requirements: Graduate in any discipline with a one-year computer diploma, Strong written communication Proficiency in MS-Office/Open Office and Google Maps 
 Additional Requirements: Must have personal conveyance for commuting Male candidate required Should be comfortable to work in rotational shifts.

Key Skills: Sales Service,Customer retention,Retention,Management,After sales service,Electronics,Team management,Operational Support
